title: Home Recomp
summary: Four 45-minute dumbbell sessions a week for a busy desk worker who wants to lose belly fat without losing strength. Knee-friendly: no jumps, no deep lunges, split squats are kept short-range.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.note: Learn the movements, stop 2-3 reps before failure, build the habit.

phases.name: Progression
phases.note: Add a set to the main lifts, push to 1-2 reps before failure, intervals get longer.

phases.name: Peak
phases.note: Heaviest weights of the cycle, last set of each main lift to technical failure.

progression: Double progression: when you hit the top of the rep range on every set, add the smallest dumbbell step (1-2 kg) next session and drop back to the bottom of the range.

exercises.name: DB floor press
exercises.how: Lie on the floor, elbows at 45 degrees, pause when triceps touch the floor, press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Pull-ups (band assisted)
exercises.how: Full hang at the bottom, chest to the bar. Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling DB press
exercises.how: One knee down, squeeze the glute of that leg, press straight up without leaning back.

exercises.name: Chest-supported DB row
exercises.how: Chest on an incline bench or a backpack on a chair, pull elbows to hips, pause 1 s.

exercises.name: DB lateral raise
exercises.how: Slight forward lean, lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.how: Feet wide, hips still, tap the opposite shoulder slowly.

days.name: Lower A
warmup: Bodyweight box squat to a chair x10

exercises.name: DB Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Soft knees, push hips back until hamstrings are tight, keep dumbbells close to the legs.

exercises.name: Goblet box squat
exercises.how: Sit back to a chair or box at knee height, pause, stand up. The box keeps the knee comfortable.

exercises.name: Short-range split squat
exercises.how: Back knee stops a hand's width above the floor. Stay pain-free, the range can grow later.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.how: Drive through the heel, ribs down, hold the top for 2 s.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.how: On a step edge, full stretch at the bottom, 1 s squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.how: Lower back pressed into the floor, move opposite arm and leg slowly.

cooldown: Hamstring stretch on the floor 30 s each
Couch stretch 30 s each (gentle on the knee)

days.name: Active rest
days.note: 8 000+ steps. 10 minutes of easy mobility in the evening if you feel stiff.

days.name: Upper B

exercises.name: One-arm DB row
exercises.how: Hand and knee on a bench or sofa, pull the dumbbell to the hip, do not twist.

exercises.name: Push-ups (tempo)
exercises.how: 3 seconds down, chest touches a fist on the floor, explode up. Elevate hands if form breaks.

exercises.name: Seated DB shoulder press
exercises.how: Back supported, dumbbells start at ear level, press up without arching.

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.how: Band at face height, pull to the forehead with thumbs pointing back, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: DB hammer curl
exercises.how: Palms facing each other, elbows pinned, no swinging.

exercises.name: Overhead DB triceps extension
exercises.how: One dumbbell in both hands, elbows forward, lower behind the head and extend.

cooldown: Lat stretch on a door frame 30 s each

days.name: Rest
days.note: Full rest. Sleep 7.5+ hours, hit your protein.

days.name: Lower B + conditioning
warmup: Easy cycling or brisk walk 3 min

exercises.name: DB sumo deadlift
exercises.how: Wide stance, one heavy dumbbell between the feet, chest up, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Hip thrust on a sofa
exercises.how: Upper back on the sofa edge, dumbbell on the hips, chin tucked, full lockout.

exercises.name: Step-up to a low step
exercises.how: Step 20-30 cm high, drive through the whole foot, control the way down.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.how: Elbow under the shoulder, body in one line, hips high.

exercises.name: Low-impact intervals
exercises.how: Fast marching with high knees, shadow boxing or a bike. Hard but no jumping.

days.name: Long walk
days.note: 60 minutes outdoors at a pace where you can still talk. Weekly weigh-in in the morning.

safety: Stop any exercise that causes sharp knee pain and use the swap instead.
If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check the plan with your GP before starting the intervals.
